verdict.rationale: Godot exposes real, documented scriptable interfaces — EditorScript for running arbitrary editor-side code, EditorInterface for creating/editing scenes and objects, EditorPlugin/GDExtension for deeper tooling, and a command-line interface for headless project export/build automation. Together these let a script (and by extension an agent invoking GDScript/CLI) create scenes and nodes, edit properties, and trigger builds. However, this is a general scripting/plugin API for developers, not an agent-oriented or externally-callable API (no REST/RPC/MCP endpoint, no llms.txt or OpenAPI per probes), and EditorScript is documented as run manually from the editor UI (Ctrl+Shift+X) rather than a clean out-of-process automation hook. Missing for 10: an externally-invokable automation/RPC interface (e.g., MCP server or headless editor API) for agents to drive the editor without being inside the GDScript runtime, and explicit documentation/examples of AI-agent-driven workflows.
